verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's docs say it is self-hosted and 'built to run entirely offline,' with native Ollama support and OpenAI-compatible APIs. The connect-a-model docs name Ollama, vLLM and LM Studio as OpenAI-compatible backends via a custom Base URL, and an air-gapped deployment mode is documented. missing for 10: llama.cpp not explicitly named in evidence, no independent or hands-on corroboration of a fully local, cloud-free setup.
